changelog: - **Parameter fields: type a negative or long number freely.** In the Properties panel's Value, Min, Max and Step fields of a Parameter, and in the Inputs list's value field, what you type now stays in the field until it is a number; before, each keystroke was stored at once, so a leading minus sign became 0 and a value too large to hold (such as 1e400) made the Parameter unreadable until Undo. An unfinished entry is dropped when you leave the field; the stored value changes only when the text is a number.
